import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.io import mmread
from scipy import sparse

meta = pd.read_csv('spatial_q_sc_metadata.csv', index_col=0)
sc = pd.read_csv('spatial_q_sc_counts.csv', index_col=0)
print('meta', meta.shape, meta.index[:3].tolist(), meta.index[-3:].tolist())
print('sc', sc.shape)
print(meta['cell_type'].value_counts())
M = mmread('matrix.mtx.gz').tocsr()
print('spatial', M.shape, type(M), 'nnz', M.nnz, 'sum', M.sum())
barcodes = pd.read_csv('barcodes.tsv.gz', header=None)[0]
features = pd.read_csv('features.tsv.gz', sep='\\t', header=None)
print('barcodes', len(barcodes), barcodes[710])
print('features', features.shape, features.head())
# target column 710
x = np.asarray(M[:,710].todense()).ravel()
print('target sum', x.sum(), 'nnz', (x>0).sum(), 'min/max', x.min(), x.max())
print('target first nonzero', [(int(i), int(v)) for i,v in zip(np.flatnonzero(x)[:30], x[x>0][:30])])
# type mean raw and normalized, top genes by means
scv=sc.to_numpy(dtype=float)
for typ, idx in meta.groupby('cell_type').groups.items():
    a=scv[idx,:]
    print('\\nTYPE', typ, 'n',len(idx),'mean total',a.sum(1).mean(), 'first means', np.round(a[:,:60].mean(0),2))
    print('top mean genes', [(sc.columns[i], round(a[:,i].mean(),2), round(a[:,i].std(),2)) for i in np.argsort(a.mean(0))[-20:][::-1]])
# correlation target with type avg on all genes and log etc
means = {}
for typ, idx in meta.groupby('cell_type').groups.items(): means[typ]=scv[idx,:].mean(0)
for normname, f in [('raw',lambda a:a),('log1p',lambda a:np.log1p(a)),('binary',lambda a:(a>0).astype(float))]:
    tx=f(x)
    print('\\n',normname)
    for typ,mu in means.items():
      v=f(mu)
      print(typ, 'corr',np.corrcoef(tx,v)[0,1], 'cos', tx.dot(v)/(np.linalg.norm(tx)*np.linalg.norm(v)), 'dot',tx.dot(v))
PY"

/bin/bash -lc "python -u - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.io import mmread
from scipy.optimize import nnls
meta=pd.read_csv('spatial_q_sc_metadata.csv',index_col=0); sc=pd.read_csv('spatial_q_sc_counts.csv',index_col=0); M=mmread('matrix.mtx.gz').tocsr()
x=np.asarray(M[:,710].todense()).ravel().astype(float)
types=sorted(meta.cell_type.unique())
means=np.stack([sc.loc[meta.cell_type==t].to_numpy(float).mean(0) for t in types])
print('types',types)
for ranges in [None, [(0,50),(50,100),(100,150),(150,200),(200,250),(250,300)], [(0,300)], [(0,50),(50,100),(100,150),(150,200),(200,250),(250,300),(300,1000)]]:
 print('\\nRANGES',ranges)
 if ranges is None: continue
 for lo,hi in ranges:
  print(lo,hi,'spot',int(x[lo:hi].sum()),'means',np.round(means[:,lo:hi].sum(1),1))
# NNLS raw target; normalize profiles by total to expected fractions
for subset_name, ix in [('all',np.arange(1000)),('markers',np.arange(300)),('rest',np.arange(300,1000))]:
 A=means[:,ix].T
 y=x[ix]
 c,res=nnls(A,y)
 print('\\nNNLS',subset_name,'coeff',dict(zip(types,np.round(c,4))), 'predsum',c.sum(), 'resnorm',res, 'rel',res/np.linalg.norm(y))
 # normalized proportions profile
 An=(means[:,ix]/means[:,ix].sum(1,keepdims=True)).T
 cn,resn=nnls(An,y/y.sum())
 print('fraction coeff',dict(zip(types,np.round(cn,4))), 'resnorm',resn)
# least squares unconstrained
c=np.linalg.lstsq(means.T,x,rcond=None)[0]
print('\\nOLS',dict(zip(types,np.round(c,4))), 'pred sum',c.sum(), 'res',np.linalg.norm(means.T@c-x))
PY"
